explanation: OEIS A280864 (lexicographically earliest infinite sequence of distinct positive terms such that, for every prime p, every run of consecutive multiples of p has length exactly 2): 'Conjectured to be a permutation of the positive integers.' The formal Eligible encodes the run rule locally: primes newly present in the previous term must divide the candidate, and primes in both of the last two terms must not. Greedy choice of the least unused eligible value (FollowsRule, from 1, 2) is the lexicographically earliest sequence, since a valid continuation always exists. The statement asserts a rule-following sequence hitting every positive integer; because the greedy rule determines the sequence uniquely, this is surjectivity of A280864. Faithful.
